name: visual-editorial
description: A type-led, art-directed visual language for delivered web apps: warm paper and ink with one rust accent, serif display type over a clean sans UI, asymmetric generous margins, hairlines and no shadows. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for marketing, portfolio, publishing, and premium services.

name: visual-glass
description: Frosted — airy, premium, layered. A glassmorphic visual language for delivered web apps: a vibrant gradient field with drifting orbs behind frosted panels, 1px translucent borders, 16–20px radii and white text on glass. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for AI, media, music, crypto, and dashboards.

name: visual-minimal
description: Barely-there restraint — precise, calm, engineered. A minimal visual language for delivered web apps in the Linear/Stripe school: near-white and ink with one indigo accent, a tight system-sans scale, hairline borders, generous whitespace, 8px radii and quick quiet motion. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for SaaS, dev tools, productivity, and fintech.

name: visual-neubrutal
description: The loud one — playful, raw, memorable. An unapologetic visual language for delivered web apps: saturated primaries on cream with black everywhere, chunky uppercase grotesk type with tight tracking, blocky offset layouts, 3px borders with 4–6px hard offset shadows and zero radius. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for creative studios, youth brands, dev tools, and games.

name: visual-swiss
description: The grid — objective, precise, graphic. A systematic typographic visual language for delivered web apps: black and white with one vermilion accent, grotesque type with heavy weights and uppercase labels, a strict left-aligned grid with numbered sections and 2–3px rules, sharp corners and no shadows. Applied as a pure CSS/token layer over the app's chosen design system — best for corporate, finance, B2B, engineering, and data docs.
